Substituting given vectors into the formula for the scalar triple product, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}a\cdot (b\times c) & =⟨-\sqrt{8},\,4,\,-3⟩\cdot ⟨\sqrt{8},\,-1,\,2⟩ \\  & =(-\sqrt{8})(\sqrt{8})+(4)(-1)+(-3)(2) \\  & =-8-4-6 \\  & =-18.\end{aligned}
$$
